faqTitle: No question too small, no doubt left hanging.

faq.question: What’s your engagement model?
faq.answer: Scoped projects, retainers, or embedded in your team. Async-first, demos every week. No surprises, except the pleasant kind.

faq.question: How do you ensure quality?
faq.answer: CI/CD, automated tests, linting, performance budgets and observability. Quality with receipts, not vibes. (This very site fails its own build if it gets slower.)

faq.question: What stacks do you prefer?
faq.answer: TypeScript and Node.js on AWS, with React/Next.js up front and PostgreSQL underneath. Python when the job calls for it. Loyal to the problem, not the framework.

faq.question: What industries have you worked in?
faq.answer: Fifteen and counting: fintech, insurtech, healthtech, legal, GIS and mining, education, e-commerce, media… 30+ projects across 12 countries. Turns out bugs are the same in every language.

faq.question: Can you work in regulated environments?
faq.answer: Yes. I've led production systems under SOC 2, cut security findings by 90%, and sat in the hot seat during investor technical due diligence. The auditors brought hard questions; I brought answers.

faq.question: Can you handle cloud infrastructure?
faq.answer: AWS is home: Lambda, CDK, RDS, IAM, the works. I've trimmed bills by ~30% without anyone noticing, except accounting. I read IAM policies for fun, which worries my friends.

faq.question: Can you rescue legacy codebases?
faq.answer: Yes. Like Indiana Jones, but instead of a whip, I use git bisect. Strapi upgrades, jQuery-to-React rewrites, migrations of millions of records — all without stopping the show.

faq.question: Do you do AI and automation?
faq.answer: Yes: AWS Bedrock, LangChain, multi-model workflows, and plenty of Make/n8n plumbing. If it can be automated, I'll automate it. If it can't, I'll write a very polite script and try anyway.

faq.question: Do you work solo or with teams?
faq.answer: Both. I've led and mentored engineers across time zones, and I'm just as happy as the striker who scores alone. Code reviews are where I do my best Jedi-master impression.

faq.question: How do you communicate?
faq.answer: Async by default, clear always: Slack, email, Notion, Loom. Carrier pigeon available on request, SLA not guaranteed.

faq.question: How do you handle deadlines?
faq.answer: With respect, caffeine and ruthless prioritization. Scope gets negotiated early, so the deadline never has to be negotiated late.

faq.question: What’s your philosophy on software design?
faq.answer: Build for humans, optimize for scale, and write code the next developer won't curse at 2 a.m. That next developer is usually me.

faq.question: What makes you different from other devs?
faq.answer: I speak both business and code, and translate between them without losing anything on the way. Plus a sense of humor sharp enough to cut through legacy spaghetti.

faq.question: Why should we hire you?
faq.answer: Because I don’t just write code — I build leverage. Your problem gets solved, your team gets faster, and the meetings get a little funnier.
